description: This file defines the 'Subscription' model class within the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for retrieving subscription data and statistics from the database. It includes methods for fetching subscription lists, counts, and filtering by status and date ranges.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: A model class in the OpenCart admin extension for interacting with subscription data, extending the core engine model class.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription records with filters for status, date range, grouping, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions based on optional filtering criteria.
